app.name: WiQus
app.description: Fast quiz decks built from live Wikipedia data. Flags, arms, languages, cars — and anything the community creates.

home.heroPlayText: Pick a category below and start swiping. Quick rounds, real facts from Wikipedia.
home.heroJoinText: Keep your streaks — and start a team to settle who's actually the smartest.
home.installBody: Add WiQus to your home screen for a full-screen, one-tap experience — no App Store needed.
home.installIosStep1: Tap the Share button in Safari
home.installIosStep2: Scroll and choose “Add to Home Screen”
home.installIosStep3: Tap Add — the icon appears on your home screen
home.installGeneric: In your browser menu, choose “Install app” or “Add to Home Screen”. On a phone it usually sits under Share or ⋮.

auth.name: Name
auth.whySimple: Just a nickname and password — email is optional (parents' address works for recovery).
auth.why: Your progress saves to the account, and you'll be able to create your own games.

social.inviteHelp: Share the link or QR — anyone who opens it joins the team (after sign-up if they don’t have an account yet).
social.inviteHint: Have them scan the code or open the link to join
